description: This file defines the DVB EIT (Event Information Table) class and its nested ServiceIterator class, including constants, enums, and methods for parsing and iterating over DVB EIT data structures. It includes references to other modules like MPEGDescriptor, MPEGSection, and Module.

classes.name: WPEFramework::Broadcast::DVB::EIT
classes.description: Represents the DVB Event Information Table, providing methods to access transport stream ID, original network ID, and iterate over services.

classes.name: WPEFramework::Broadcast::DVB::EIT::ServiceIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for traversing services within an EIT, providing methods to check validity, move to next service, and access service properties.

methods.name: EIT::IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the EIT object contains valid data.

methods.name: EIT::TransportStreamId
methods.description: Returns the transport stream ID associated with the EIT.

methods.name: EIT::OriginalNetworkId
methods.description: Returns the original network ID from the EIT data.

methods.name: EIT::Services
methods.description: Returns an iterator to traverse the services contained in the EIT.

methods.name: ServiceIterator::IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the current service iterator points to a valid service.

methods.name: ServiceIterator::Next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next service.

methods.name: ServiceIterator::EIT_PF
methods.description: Returns whether the service is a present/following event.

methods.name: ServiceIterator::EIT_Schedule
methods.description: Returns whether the service is scheduled.

methods.name: ServiceIterator::IsFreeToAir
methods.description: Indicates if the service is free-to-air.

methods.name: ServiceIterator::RunningMode
methods.description: Returns the current running mode of the service.

methods.name: ServiceIterator::Descriptors
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the descriptors associated with the service.

methods.name: ServiceIterator::Services
methods.description: Counts the number of services within the current data element.
